correctness.rationale: The R-encoding is explicitly specified, including all loops, layers, markers, and data edges; the root test and bit test are valid on each tag. The precisely (t+2)-edge path with loop-free internals recovers each S_i. A nested chain with rebinding uses only three variable names and has O(t) size. For each CoR circuit gate the M^2 tag blocks lift Boolean/complement/converse exactly; the identity for relational composition gives at most M^3 new composition gates per old gate. The resulting circuit computes Uezato Φ_k on every finite base structure, so his Theorem 1.3 gives the claimed \(2^{k-1}/M_k^3\) bound. Executed finite checker gave 640 agreement checks; no finite test substitutes for the argument or the cited source theorem.

value.rationale: A recently proved optimal exponential FO3/CoR gap explicitly did not resolve its one-symbol signature restriction. This quantified \(2^{\Omega(s/\log s)}\) bound addresses the same fixed-signature research gap while controlling circuit DAG reuse and free Boolean/complement/converse gates. The algebraic block lifting is structural and allows future attempts to remove the logarithmic coding overhead; it is more than a fixed small example or table and does not overclaim the full exponential result.
